[David Whipp](https://davewhipp.github.io/markdown-cv/) is a professor of geodynamic modeling at the [University of Helsinki, Finland](https://www.helsinki.fi/en/) and leader of the [Helsinki University Geodynamics Group (HUGG)](https://helsinki.fi/geodynamics).
